title: unread_ids_from_loaded_messages collects ALL inbound messages as unread including already-read ones
description: unread_ids_from_loaded_messages marks every inbound message (senderId \!= 'self') as unread, including messages the user already read in a previous session. This means every chat switch and startup triggers a batch Message/set update marking all historic inbound messages as read again. This is wrong: a message already has readAt set on the server — re-sending a receipt is wasteful but mostly harmless except it generates unnecessary state changes that trigger further SSE events, potentially causing an event storm. The server should ignore redundant readAt sets (idempotent), but the TUI is sending O(n) unnecessary JMAP updates for every chat load. The fix is to filter only messages where readAt is null/missing.
